caveats: The Q4 2023 value is derived (full-year minus nine-month year-to-date), not a directly reported quarterly figure.
The two inputs come from different filings: the full-year figure from accession 0001018724-26-000004 and the nine-month figure from accession 0001018724-24-000161.

claims.text: Amazon's operating income for fiscal Q4 2023 (2023-10-01 to 2023-12-31) was $13,209,000,000 (about $13.21 billion), derived as FY2023 operating income of $36,852,000,000 minus the nine-month (Jan 1 to Sep 30, 2023) operating income of $23,643,000,000.

raw_output.summary: Amazon's operating income in fiscal Q4 2023 (October 1 to December 31, 2023) was about $13.21 billion ($13,209,000,000). This is a derived value: FY2023 operating income of $36,852,000,000 minus the nine-month figure of $23,643,000,000.
